critical_code_review_comments: server.py PUT /api/profile now uses model_dump(exclude_unset=True) — merge semantics confirmed working for partial updates (age preserved after {targetWeight:75.5} PUT). The regression noted in iteration_6 is RESOLVED.

ShoppingListPanel.boughtToFridge sends the FULL merged array via PUT /api/profile (fridgeItems) rather than a dedicated /fridge/add endpoint — fine today since PUT is merge-safe, but still a client-side race if two tabs edit concurrently. Consider /api/fridge/add batching endpoint, similar to /shopping-list/add.

SupplementsPanel: stock cards and the Dashboard low-stock banner both call GET /api/supplements/stock separately on mount — small duplicated LLM-free call but worth hoisting to Dashboard state and passing down.

BarcodeScanner.readLabel: sends the raw dataURL image_base64 up to 8 MB; backend to_jpeg_b64 downscales to 1600 px — ok, but add client-side size cap + user feedback if the file is >10 MB to avoid long waits.

WeightGoalChart.slope: linear regression with <7 points is noisy; the code already falls back to a standard estimate (+0.25 or -0.5 kg/sett) when direction is wrong — correct, but the Math.sign(0) edge case means a perfectly flat 2-point history (same weight) uses fallback. Acceptable.
server.py /api/foods/label returns the AI JSON verbatim including readable:false — ok, but there is no persistence; good because BarcodeScanner saves via /foods/custom afterwards.
